title: A help question sent from an older member app can get a team reply the member never sees, while HQ says they will see it
what: Team replies to help questions reach a member only when the app sent a secret with the question; the server finds replies by that secret alone. Member app versions from before that change still post help questions, and the server saves them with the AI's answer, so HQ shows them in Needs reply with a reply box. When the team replies, HQ says 'They see it the next time they open the app', but that phone has no way to fetch the reply, and the question is then marked done. Existing members on an older app are never told to update to see replies.
expected: HQ marks a question that cannot get a reply in the app ('This person is on an older app and will not see a reply') and does not count it as answered, or the reply waits and is handed over once that phone updates.
who: members on an older app version, and the MettleUp team
how_often: every help question from an app version older than the reply feature
fix_line: Show in HQ when a question has no reply secret, and say plainly that the person will not see the reply

items.reason: Small-database changes are additive with defaults and the code carries on when one is not applied (0014 still not applied; which ones are live is an existing finding). Join, invite and check-in pages are sent no-cache; the gym name and logo are kept 5 minutes; the admin page itself comes from the static files and its offline copy is network first, so a deploy is picked up on the next load. The What's new lines are always the newest release's, also for Play users on an older version (existing finding). Watch, phone-version and Play-vs-sideload parts do not apply to this web server beyond the app download link, which points at the newest release.

Staff who leave: every desk call asks the gym server who the key belongs to, so a removed person is refused at once. Trial and plan end: the AI Assistant switches to the trial allowance and shared monthly cap (a trial gym can be told it is resting: existing finding). Gym closed: the join page says it is not taking sign-ups; a deleted gym leaves payment keys behind (existing). Months are India months keyed by year, so year end is safe; the import date check knows leap days. Payment links last 7 days and members see their requests for 30 days; a paid join request drops off Today after 45 days (existing). Day boundaries differ between limits (existing). Owner changing phone: sign-in keys are not tied to a device here.

Team replies in the app work only for questions sent by newer apps. Other new rules here cover existing users: AI credits skip older apps with no key, and gyms with no payment-switch row read both switches as on.
No path for an older-app question: HQ offers the reply box and says they will see it.

The bell news is the same last 120 days for every gym with no gym start date, so a brand-new gym counts older messages as new (existing finding). The What's new feed always serves the newest release's lines (existing finding).
Rule applied: the one new-mark fault is already written.
